commands.rule: The candidate catalogue is discovery metadata. Only implemented commands with a built target binary are binary-backed; unknown commands remain provider-missing or discovery-only.

isa.rule: ISA instructions/encodings are not command binaries. Execution requires a target-specific backend and architecture conformance tests.

architecture_builds.artifact_abi: Linux ELF cross-build artifact; not automatically a Koronos-native executable
architecture_builds.runtime_gate: Validate loader/syscall ABI and actual Koronos runtime behavior before inclusion in an ISO.

current_kernel_runtime: The current published native Koronos release is AMD64. Cross-built command artifacts do not establish non-AMD64 kernel support.
